Package com.j3d.engine.scene.nodes.geometry

Class GObject

java.lang.Object
com.j3d.engine.react.events.EventEmitter
com.j3d.engine.scene.nodes.geometry.GObject
All Implemented Interfaces:
EventEmitterInterface, EventListener, CanCopy, SceneObject, HasProperties
Direct Known Subclasses:
GCurve, GLine, GPoint, GTri
public abstract class GObject extends EventEmitter implements EventListener, CanCopy, SceneObject
Graphics Object is an abstract class that represents any actual tangible Geometry in the 3d space (Cartesian space) that a user can see and interact with. This only has 3 extenders, GPoint, GLine and GTri as these form the base objects and cannot be broken down further.

Any GObject also has event listening and emitting capabilities as an extender of EventEmitter and an implementor of EventListener. It is up to the child classes to decide which events it wants to listen to or emit.

Lehlogonolo Poole
